request.text: We've just boarded the airport express. In 35 minutes, remind me to get off at Central Station and transfer to bus 24.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder 35 minutes from now to get off at Central Station and transfer to bus 24.

new_goals.description: Schedule a relative-time reminder for the airport-express transfer at Central Station.
new_goals.source_text: We've just boarded the airport express. In 35 minutes, remind me to get off at Central Station and transfer to bus 24.
constraints: Trigger 35 minutes after the admitted request.
Preserve Central Station as the exit point and bus 24 as the transfer.
Do not convert the relative schedule into a location-based trigger.
success_criteria: A reminder is created for the requested 35-minute offset with the complete transfer instruction.

semantic_facts: The plan should preserve the 35-minute offset from the admitted request and prepare one reminder.create Work item containing Central Station and bus 24.
Reminder creation must remain behind confirmation, and the confirmation wording should not imply live train-position awareness or a location trigger.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims before confirmation that the reminder is created, active, or counting down.
The assistant claims it is tracking the airport express, knows when Central Station is reached, or will physically perform the transfer.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A relative reminder is converted into an unsupported live-location or vehicle-tracking workflow.
The urgency of an in-progress journey causes reminder creation to bypass confirmation or be described as already underway.
